models.name: Model A
models.explanation: Quantitative price features. The reference for the incremental SEC comparison.

models.name: Model B / R0
models.explanation: Original fixed-XGBoost Model B adds SEC evidence to prices. R0 still selects trades.

models.name: B+rule+ou · bag5
models.explanation: Adds the reversion rule and Ornstein–Uhlenbeck features, bagged over five seeds. The preregistered Goal 1 choice; improved forecasting did not select a better book.

models.name: B+rule+ou+track · bag5
models.explanation: Adds pair-track features. Best observed point estimates, chosen after inspection; not an independent confirmation of model selection.

2018–2023 · confirmation.definition: Fresh |z| >= 2 divergence; convergence to |z| <= 0.5 within 20 sessions before |z| >= 3. Matched labelled walk-forward events.

2010–2017 · selection.definition: Fresh |z| >= 2 divergence; convergence to |z| <= 0.5 within 20 sessions before |z| >= 3. Matched labelled walk-forward events.

source: demo/book export; docs/FORECASTING_AND_BOOK.md; Decisions 105–117. Development periods were reused during research; not an untouched final test.
precision: Forecast metrics are rounded published point estimates. Per-event current-model predictions, uncertainty and calibration arrays are not included. Hashes identify presentation bytes, not scientific acceptance.
